gtm_account: Google Tag Manager account operations (get, list, update): the top-level container for all of an organization's GTM containers and user permissions.
gtm_built_in_variable: Google Tag Manager built-in variable operations (create, list, remove, revert): GTM's predefined variables like Page URL, Click Element, or Event.
gtm_client: Google Tag Manager server-side client operations (create, get, list, update, remove, revert): the component in a Server GTM container that parses incoming requests (e.g. GA4, GTAG) into events.
gtm_container: Google Tag Manager container operations (create, get, update, remove, list, combine, lookup, moveTagId, snippet): a container holds a site's or app's tags, triggers, and variables, and is identified by a GTM-XXXXXXX id.
gtm_destination: Google Tag Manager destination operations (get, list, link, unlink): linking a container to a Google Ads or other destination account.
gtm_environment: Google Tag Manager environment operations (create, get, list, update, remove, reauthorize): named deploy targets (e.g. Live, Staging, Latest) for a container, each with its own snippet.
gtm_folder: Google Tag Manager folder operations (create, get, list, update, remove, revert, entities, moveEntitiesToFolder): a folder is purely organizational, grouping tags/triggers/variables together in the GTM UI; it is not itself a tag or trigger.
gtm_gtag_config: Google Tag Manager Google tag (gtag.js) config operations (create, get, list, update, remove): configuration for the direct Google tag, separate from GTM tags created with gtm_tag.
gtm_tag: Google Tag Manager tag operations (create, get, list, update, remove, revert): a tag is a snippet of tracking/marketing code (e.g. Google Analytics, conversion pixel, HTML snippet) that fires when its trigger conditions are met.
gtm_template: Google Tag Manager custom template operations (create, get, list, update, remove, revert): reusable custom tag or variable templates built in the GTM template gallery.
gtm_transformation: Google Tag Manager server-side transformation operations (create, get, list, update, remove, revert): a transformation modifies or enriches incoming event data in a Server GTM container before it reaches a tag or client.
gtm_trigger: Google Tag Manager trigger operations (create, get, list, update, remove, revert): a trigger is the firing condition (e.g. page view, click, form submit) that causes a tag to run.
gtm_user_permission: Google Tag Manager user permission operations (create, get, list, update, remove): who can access a GTM account or container and at what permission level.
gtm_variable: Google Tag Manager variable operations (create, get, list, update, remove, revert): a variable is a named value (e.g. a data layer field, constant, or lookup table) that tags and triggers can read.
gtm_version: Google Tag Manager container version operations (get, live, publish, remove, setLatest, undelete, update): a version is a published, point-in-time snapshot of a container's tags/triggers/variables.
gtm_version_header: Google Tag Manager container version header operations (list, latest): lightweight metadata (name, id, date) about a container's published versions, without their full contents.
gtm_workspace: Google Tag Manager workspace operations (create, get, list, update, remove, createVersion, getStatus, sync, quickPreview, resolveConflict): a workspace is a draft area for editing tags/triggers/variables before publishing a version.
gtm_zone: Google Tag Manager zone operations (create, get, list, update, remove, revert): a zone boundary isolates part of a container, used to safely test or roll out changes.
